rules.condition: is this bot's current health below 25% of its maximum health?
rules.criteria_true: health is less than one quarter of max
rules.criteria_false: health is greater than or equal to one quarter of max

rules.condition: is a visible enemy inside melee range of this bot?
rules.criteria_true: an enemy is within melee distance
rules.criteria_false: no enemy is within melee distance

rules.condition: is there a visible enemy cluster (densest) within attack range?
rules.criteria_true: a dense cluster of enemies is visible and reachable
rules.criteria_false: no dense cluster is available or out of range

rules.condition: are there no immediate threats and the bot is in a safe position to attack?
rules.criteria_true: the lane is clear of melee threats and minions are present
rules.criteria_false: a threat exists or the lane is empty

rules.condition: is there no enemy within attack range and the bot is not low on health?
rules.criteria_true: no enemy is in attack range and hp is safe
rules.criteria_false: an enemy is in attack range or hp is critical
